Container.Name: ProxyWake
Container.Overview: ProxyWake wakes sleeping devices on your network when they are accessed through a reverse proxy. Built for Nginx Proxy Manager, Traefik, Caddy and homelab setups. Uses host networking so Wake-on-LAN broadcasts reach your LAN; the web UI runs on port 5001.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Web interface port. With host networking the UI is always on port 5001 of the Unraid IP; this mapping only applies if you switch the network type to bridge.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent application data: database, logs, API key and settings.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone for scheduled wakes, e.g. Europe/Amsterdam or America/New_York.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: Optional. Web UI login password. Leave empty to set it in the first-run setup wizard.

Config.Name: Secret Key
Config.Description: Optional. ProxyWake generates and stores a secret automatically. Only set your own (32+ random characters) if you want to control it, e.g. to restore a backup on another machine.

Config.Name: Allowed Origins
Config.Description: Optional. Comma-separated browser origins allowed to call the API, e.g. https://proxywake.example.com. Leave empty for direct access via the Unraid IP.

Config.Name: Session Cookie Secure
Config.Description: Set to true only when ProxyWake is opened through HTTPS. Keep false for plain HTTP access via the Unraid IP.
